intuition: A dense value list gives constant-time random indexing, while per-value index sets locate a removable occurrence.

brute_force.approach: Store values in a list, scan for a value to remove, and choose a random position.
brute_force.time: insert O(1), remove O(n), getRandom O(1)

optimal.approach: Store every occurrence in a list and swap a removed occurrence with the last element while updating both index sets.
optimal.time: insert O(1) average, remove O(1) average, getRandom O(1)

edge_cases: Inserting a duplicate returns false but still adds one occurrence.
Removing one occurrence leaves other equal values available.
